text: スーパー　おにいさんショー　…って　ほどでも　ないけど　はじめまーす！

structure.jp: スーパー　おにいさんショー
…って　ほどでも　ないけど
structure.en: ...well, it's not really that much, but

patterns.name: 〜というほどでもない
patterns.span: …って　ほどでも　ない
patterns.explanation: This says 'it is not so much that you could call it that'. って is the casual short form of という. …って　ほどでも　ない = 'it's not really grand enough to be called that'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. ないけど = 'it isn't, but'.
